title: N-Slits
description: Interference from 1 to 16 slits in an analytical paraxial packet model, in the Orthodox, Pilot-Wave and Many-Worlds views. Slits can be opened, closed or given ideal which-slit detectors during a run; in Pilot Wave the screen shows which band each slit's particles reach. Includes a Nice fringes search, a quiz, and a discussion of near- and far-field patterns.
